title: Maria's Week
text:
Maria is fifteen years old. She goes to school in the morning and plays football with her friends after class. On weekends, she likes to read books and watch films with her sister.

Her parents want her to save money. So, Maria works in a shop on Saturdays. She earns a little money, and she is very happy with her new job.

questions.text: What does Maria do on Saturdays?
Why is Maria happy with her new job?
options: She earns money and likes the work
She has no friends at school
She wants to stop going to school

questions.text: What kind of person is Maria most likely to be?

vocabulary.definition: Saturday and Sunday, the two days at the end of the week
to keep money so you can use it later
a place where you buy things

paragraph_translations: Maria tiene quince años. Va a la escuela por la mañana y juega al fútbol con sus amigos después de clase. Los fines de semana, le gusta leer libros y ver películas con su hermana.
Sus padres quieren que ahorre dinero. Por eso, Maria trabaja en una tienda los sábados. Gana un poco de dinero y está muy contenta con su nuevo trabajo.
